mainEntity.name: How long does an accessible bathroom remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an accessible bathroom remodel varies based on the scope and complexity of the project. A basic conversion, such as installing grab bars and a raised toilet, might take a few days, while a complete renovation involving structural changes, like a roll-in shower and wider doorways, could take several weeks. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed timeline during the planning phase, taking into account material delivery and inspection schedules.
acceptedAnswer.description: An accessible bathroom remodel can take from a few days for minor changes to several weeks for a full renovation, depending on project scope. Timelines are detailed during planning.
